//: v1.100.1 - 'Claude outputs' is where the desktop app drops files it could not place, and it is INSIDE this project. next build type-checks everything tsconfig includes, so one stray worker file in there (hotels.ts, whose imports resolve from worker/src) failed the whole website build after the API had already published.
